records.text: Laura Loomer alleged that George Farmer drunkenly crashed into Tracy Robinson's car while possessing a firearm as a green-card holder in Nashville.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: Do you want me to land a hit like your husband, George Farmer, allegedly landed when he allegedly hit, aka crashed into Tracy Robinson's car while he was allegedly driving drunk with an alleged firearm in his possession as a green card holder in Nashville, Tennessee, where you live?

verification.notes: The source episode preserves the quoted Loomer post, and Loomer later published expanded claims about an alleged Nashville DUI and firearm-related records. This verifies that Loomer made the allegation, not that Farmer committed the alleged conduct.

records.text: Candace Owens confirmed that her insurance paid Tracy Robinson a total of 6,987 dollars.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I learned his name when Laura (Laura Loomer) dug up the fact that my insurance did pay a Tracy Robinson $6,987. ... As she said, you can find this on Nashville courts and it is true. As you can see, a grand total of $6,987.

verification.notes: Owens publicly said the insurer paid Tracy Robinson 6,987 dollars and displayed what she described as a Nashville court record. Searches found official Nashville court portals but no publicly indexed case page or authenticated document confirming the amount, so the payment itself could not be independently verified.

records.text: Candace Owens said George Farmer's incident with Tracy Robinson was a rainy daytime parking-lot fender bender with no drinking, DUI, or police involvement.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The reality is my husband got into a fender bender pulling out of a parking lot on a rainy day in broad daylight about noon, I think it was. ... The police were not even called ... There was no drinking involved. ... There was no DUI involved. There were no police called.

verification.notes: Owens gave a first-person account of a separate Tracy Robinson fender-bender, while later reports describe disputed alleged DUI records that Loomer said concerned another incident. No accessible police report, civil filing, or insurer record established the weather, time, parking-lot circumstances, or absence of police and alcohol for the Tracy Robinson incident.
